summary: The V1 timeline was built without the real VO durations. render.html calls buildTimeline(BEATS, window.VO_DUR || {}), but render.js injects window.VO, so every one of the 81 lines defaulted to 2.5 s (and every speaker to NAR). The real lines average 3.85 s. As a result: (a) the runtime is 4:50 (290.4 s), 40-70 s short of the 5:30-6:00 target; (b) 35 consecutive VO lines overlap in the mix, about 58 s of doubled voice in total (for example L001/L002 overlap by 2.3 s and L059/L060 by 3.7 s), so cuts can't land on dialogue; (c) the shot lengths are metronomic. Stats as rendered: 108 shots, mean 2.69 s, median 2.67 s, min 1.44 s, max 5.77 s. Histogram: <1.2: 0 | 1.2-2: 10 | 2-3: 75 | 3-5: 19 | 5-6: 4 | >6: 0. That puts 69% of shots in the 2-3 s band. The reference has mean 4.46 / median 2.42 with a wide spread: <1.5: 24 (25%), 1.5-3: 33, 3-5: 15, 5-8: 13, >8: 12. V1 has neither the sub-1.5 s punch cuts nor the long moving holds, so action and emotion are cut at the same tempo. No hard-limit violations (nothing <1.2 s or unmarked >6 s). Only one 3-in-a-row same-type run: S002-S005 TOP, a deliberate match-cut chain. I re-simulated buildTimeline in node with vo_data.json. With the bug fixed, the runtime is 345.2 s (5:45, on target), mean 3.20 s and median 2.70 s. Histogram: 1.2-2: 4 | 2-3: 60 | 3-5: 31 | 5-6: 8 | >6: 5. The fix creates new >6 s unmarked shots (S001 6.42, S043 6.33, S103 6.50, S104 6.67), and the rhythm is still too uniform. Visual variety is good in Acts 1-2 (TOP/ECU/INSERT/GFX/LOW mix, match cuts). It collapses in two places. The workshop (S058-S069) is 11 shots from the same eye-level angle on the same pegboard wall. The tournament dialogue (S080-S090, S097-S102) is a string of single-character MS/CU shots against the identical blurred bleachers, with no OTS or wide to give geography. Camera drift is present on most shots but is very subtle (dx 18 px, dz 0.03). S037, S073, S092, S094 and S095 are fully locked off, and S053/S054 too, with S053 having no cam at all.
strengths: Act 1 opening montage (S002-S005) and B06 failure montage use shape match cuts (keys→keyboard→page→board; ball→stool wheel→test) exactly like the reference.
The shot vocabulary is broad: 26 distinct type tags, including TOP, ECU, INSERT, GFX, LOW, POV, TELE, FLASH and rack-focus. Acts 1-2 rarely repeat a framing back to back.
No hard-limit violations in V1: nothing under 1.2 s, nothing unmarked over 6 s, and the one 5.77 s hold (S068) is marked and has in-frame time-lapse change.
Deliberate repeat framing is used for story: S046 mirrors S008, S105/S108 call back S002/S026.
Beat/anchor system (on/off/at/w) is the right architecture. Once the real durations flow in, most dialogue shots cut on line starts.

issues.problem: The timeline is built with placeholder VO durations. render.html line 23 calls buildTimeline(BEATS, window.VO_DUR || {}), while render.js line 25 injects window.VO. Every line is 2.5 s and every spk is NAR. Real lines average 3.85 s (1.3-8.4 s). Result: the runtime is 4:50 instead of 5:30-6:00, 35 VO lines overlap in the mix (58.5 s of talk-over), shots cut before lines finish, and S001's split-screen transition (atE 3.6-5.2) never plays because the shot ends at 3.5 s.
issues.fix: render.html: window.TL = buildTimeline(BEATS, window.VO || {}). Re-render. Simulated result: 345.2 s (5:45), mean 3.20 s, all overlaps gone. Then apply the per-shot fixes below against the new timings. Also add an assert in tools/build.sh that timeline.json lines don't all have dur 2.5.

issues.problem: Action and climax are cut at the same 2-2.5 s tempo as dialogue (S091-S095 run 2.03/2.03/2.54/2.44/1.96). V1 has only one shot under 1.5 s, against 25% of shots in the reference. The robot recovery has no punch.
issues.fix: act3.js B35: set minShot 1.2 and split into 7 shots at ~1.3-1.8 s. Add flash cuts with tin:'flash', dur .7-.9: S091b ECU blue backup LED igniting and S094b ECU timer 0:01. Shorten S092 GFX to dur 1.4. B29: give S076 POV dur 1.4 and S077 w .8. B28: S072 LOW tracking (5.85 s after the fix) should be split into the S072 track (2.5 s) + S072b TOP whip (1.5 s).

issues.problem: The film's key emotional beat (Noah gives up, then walks out) is marked hold:true but runs only 3.0 s and 3.2 s, shorter than the surrounding dialogue shots. Emotional beats should run 4-7 s. The silence doesn't land.
issues.fix: act3.js B24: post 3.2 → 5.0 and S066 at:-3.0 → at:-5.0, with a slow push 1.0→1.08 instead of 1.04. B25: min 3.2 → 5.5, and give S067 CAM.push(1350,600,1.0,1.06) following Noah to the door. That adds ~4 s.

issues.problem: Tournament shout-across-the-hall: 8 shots, 7 of them single-character MS/CU against the identical blurred bleacher plate at eye level (S083 CU, S084 MS, S085 MS, S086 CU, S088 CU, S089 MS, S090 MS). The FLASH S087 is the only break. There's no shot showing the distance between Eli and Noah, so it reads as a static talking-head ping-pong.
issues.fix: S084: replace with a WS from behind Eli across the hall to Noah standing in the bleachers (geography). S085: make it an OTS over Noah's shoulder down to Eli (high angle). S089: make it a LOW angle on Eli with the timer in the FG. S090: TELE push on Noah pointing (reuse S082's cam z 2.6→3.4). Keep S086 as CU.

issues.problem: The workshop sequence is 11 consecutive shots (~38 s after the fix) from the same eye-level angle on the same pegboard/window wall. S059, S061, S063 and S065 are near-identical MS framings, and S067 and S068 are near-identical wides. The contact sheet rows read as one shot.
issues.fix: S061: reverse angle from the pegboard looking toward the door/window, Eli in FG. S063 ('Fixed that too'): TOP over the workbench, Eli's hands typing and Noah's hand entering frame. S065: OTS over Noah's shoulder onto Eli's turned back. S067: shoot from the doorway outward (Noah exits toward camera, Eli small in BG) so it doesn't match S068's wide.

issues.problem: After the VO fix S001 becomes 6.42 s (unmarked >6 s). It's also the hook: the first 6 s are one locked split-screen with only z+0.02.
issues.fix: act1.js: split it. S001 split-screen (w .55, keep the panel collapse at k 3.6→ re-timed to 2.4-3.4) + S001b CU on Eli at the piano, smiling, as the narration lands '1 hour', with CAM.push 1→1.1. Add drift dx 30 to the split.

issues.problem: After the VO fix it's 6.33 s (unmarked >6 s), one WS while L031 plays.
issues.fix: act2.js B16: add S043b CU Eli reacting (mouth open) on the second half (on:'L031', off: +2.5). Or set S043 w .6 and add an INSERT of the gold ball bouncing off the desk.

issues.problem: After the VO fix these are 6.50 s and 6.67 s, unmarked. The ending resolution is two long static-ish shots back to back.
issues.fix: Mark S103 hold:true (characters walk and the camera drifts, ok ≤9 s) and give it CAM.move pan 8%. Split S104 into the INSERT stripes (3 s) + an INSERT photo push-in (3 s). Or mark it hold:true with a push 1→1.12.

issues.problem: timeline.js gives every unanchored shot min 2.2 s (b.minShot ?? 2.2), and most shots use w 1. This flattens the rhythm: 75/108 shots at 2-3 s now, 60/108 after the fix. The reference alternates very short and long shots.
issues.fix: Set pacing per beat. Action beats (B13, B14, B28, B29, B35) get minShot 1.3 and varied w (.6/.8/1.4). Emotional beats (B24-B26, B37, B38) get minShot 3.5-4. Montage beats (B02, B16, B20) get minShot 1.4. Target ≥15 shots <1.8 s and ≥10 shots 5-9 s (moving or held).

issues.problem: The apology scene is cut quickly (sim: S100 2.20 s, S101 2.30 s CU/CU ping-pong) against the same bleacher plate as the tournament. S099 and S102 are the same MS-2 framing, so the reconciliation doesn't breathe.
issues.fix: act3.js B37: gaps after L072/L073 to .7 s and minShot 3.5, giving the S100/S101 CUs 3.5-4 s each with slow pushes. Make S102 a WS profile two-shot from low (applause blur in FG) so the shoulder bump reads and differs from S099.

issues.problem: Locked-off cameras: S037 cam {960,640,1.05} static (2.3 s; 3.3 s after the fix), S073 z .98 static (2.8 s; 3.7 s after the fix), S092/S094/S095 z 1 static, S053 has no cam (3.6 s after the fix). The rule allows locked-off only for deliberate flat comedy up to 2.5 s.
issues.fix: S037: CAM.drift(960,640,1.05,.04,30). S073: CAM.push(960,540,.98,1.06). S092: CAM.push(960,560,1,1.05). S094: CAM.drift(960,560,1,.04). S095: CAM.push(960,640,1,1.12,'out'). S053/S054: keep the locked framing for the montage joke but cap each at 2.5 s (B20 pre/post 1.2/1.4 → .4/.6) or add z +.03 like S054.

issues.problem: The default CAM.drift is dx 18 px and dz .03, almost invisible at 4 fps sampling (S061, S083, S084 read as static in the frame strips). The reference's long shots get new information every 2-4 s through visible moves.
issues.fix: lib/post.js CAM.drift: raise the default dx to 30 and dz to .05. For any shot >4 s use CAM.move or push with ≥8% travel.

issues.problem: Even after the fix, the four dialogue shots alternate OTS/MS/CU/MS at 2.2-3.1 s each with no reaction cutaway. In V1 as rendered, Eli's L045 audio spills into Noah's CU S064.
issues.fix: After the VO fix, add a 1.2 s INSERT cutaway of Noah's sensor drawing being pushed aside (between S063 and S064) to vary the rhythm. Set S064 off: -.4 so the cut lands on Noah's breath before 'Dude'.

issues.problem: Four consecutive TOP shots with near-identical framing. It's a deliberate match-cut chain, but it's the only same-type run of 3+ and it sits right after the hook.
issues.fix: Keep S002-S004 as TOP match cuts. Make S005 a GFX with a pull-out (CAM.move z 1.25→.95) revealing the tactics board on a wall. Or tilt S004 15° (cam r) for variety.

issues.problem: Back-to-back information shots run long after the fix: S057 poster INSERT 5.91 s after S056 INSERT, S027 TOP 5.48 s + S028 GFX 5.65 s.
issues.fix: S057: split into poster INSERT (2.5 s) + calendar-crossing INSERT (3 s) with tin:'flash' on the page flips. S027/S028: add an ECU of Eli's face between them (B11, w .6) so the rule card isn't 11 s of graphics.

issues.problem: Only one tin:'flash' in the whole film and no whip pans. The reference uses 2-4-frame white flashes on power moments and whip-pans for energetic location changes, which create the sub-1 s cuts V1 lacks.
issues.fix: Add tin:'flash' on S038 (volley goal), S047 (A+), S095 (finish) and S096. Add a whip-pan smear on S036 (to football) and S070 (to tournament).
